label: LookupIn (sub-document read) Advanced Accessor
type: the Advanced Keyspace Accessor form of sub-document read - fetches one or more paths from a document without fetching the whole body. Analogous to sdk:subdocument-operations' lookupIn, but this is Eventing's own couchbase.lookupIn() accessor, a different API surface - not merged with the SDK concept for that reason.
aliases_note: Folds two independently-minted ids for the same operation, zero file overlap: eventing:lookupin-operation (from eventing-advanced-keyspace-accessors.md, the operation-list overview page) and eventing:lookupin-subdocument-operation (from eventing-handler-advancedLookupInOp.md, the worked demonstration page). Same genre-fork shape as the timer-callback fold above.
evidence: couchbase.lookupIn(binding, meta, spec) - Retrieves specific paths from a document without fetching the entire document.
relates_to_competency_question: Can a handler read just one field of a document without fetching the whole thing, and what is that accessor called?
